prompt: In the center of a cobblestone medieval village square, a merchant in a rough brown tunic holds up a red velvet cloth for inspection by a noblewoman wearing an emerald green dress and a gold circlet. To their left, a blacksmith with soot-stained arms leans on a heavy iron hammer resting against his wooden workbench, watching the transaction intently. Next to the blacksmith, a small boy in a patched gray shirt points excitedly at a basket of fresh apples held by a farmer in a straw hat. On the right side of the frame, a monk in a dark brown robe pours water from a clay jug into a stone basin while a stray dog with matted fur drinks eagerly from the spill. Behind them, a baker in a white apron carries a large wooden tray of golden loaves toward a customer seated on a bench. A town crier in a blue tabard stands near a stone well, holding a rolled parchment scroll high above his head. In the background, timber-framed houses with thatched roofs line the square under a bright midday sun that casts sharp shadows across the uneven stones. The lighting is natural and harsh, highlighting the textures of wool, wood, and stone. This scene is rendered as a photorealistic photo with high dynamic range and crisp focus on the central figures.
